newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL Carbon Q1 oper profit flat.
newsitem.headline: SGL Carbon Q1 oper profit flat.

text.p: WIESBADEN, Germany, April 21 - German carbon and graphite manufacturer SGL Carbon AG said on Monday its operating profit in the first quarter of 1997 approximately matched the year-earlier result of 80 million marks ($47 million).
Sales including acquisitions totalled about 450 million marks in the first quarter, up 10 percent, the company said.
The company said it was sticking by its forecast of a double-digit percentage rise in full-year profit. ($ = 1.702 German Marks)
SGL said its first-quarter results were hit by two one-off effects and that order books signalled a clear revival in the second quarter.

SGL management board chairman Ronald Koehler said in the text of a speech that in the first quarter of the previous year earnings were boosted by a special payment covering four million marks in damage sustained through an earthquake.
In addition, SGL's results in the first quarter of this year were hit by the cost of a large product recall in North America which would however be compensated in the course of the year.
Koehler was addressing the company's annual shareholder meeting.
